_note: One car image is used for every vehicle in the report, the step 2 confirmed-car card and the landing sample. Coordinates are pixels in the 1366x409 system of mazda-rx7-full.png (divide by 1366 and 409 for percentages; the 1100px file has the same aspect ratio).
tooltipAlign: left edge of tooltip at the pin when pin x < 30% of the full image width, otherwise centered
assignment: Process findings in display order (sorted HIGH, MED, LOW; the finding number is the position). For each finding take the next free slot of its category zone (unknown categories count as Body & Electrical). If that zone is full, take the next free slot from the first zone that has one, in the order Engine & Drivetrain, Body & Electrical, Chassis & Suspension, overflow. If nothing is free, no pin. Every slot has x <= 900, so the same positions are used on desktop and on the mobile crop.

landingSample.note: The landing sample card has its own fixed pins and label chips, independent of the zones.

pins.title: Apex Seal Compression Test
pins.why: Ask for a compression test printout. Each rotor should read above 8.5 bar / 120 psi.

pins.title: Coolant-in-Oil / Rotor Housing Leak
pins.why: Pull the dipstick and look for milky oil. White smoke on a cold start is the clearest warning sign.

pins.title: Catalytic Converter Condition
pins.why: Rotaries run rich and destroy catalytic converters. Listen for a rattle under the car at idle.
